name: Yehuecauhceratops
sum: Yehuecauhceratops is a small centrosaurine from the Aguja Formation of Coahuila, Mexico, known from a partial skeleton.
holotype: Partial skeleton excavated in 2007–2011 near La Salada, Ocampo, Coahuila (catalogue number not given in the sources used) — Aguja Formation, Mexico.
biology: Smaller than the other two ceratopsids of its environment, Agujaceratops and Coahuilaceratops, so the three may have been ecologically segregated.
author: Rivera-Sylva et al. 2017

sources.text: Rivera-Sylva, H.E.; Frey, E.; Stinnesbeck, W.; Guzman-Gutirrez, J.R.; Gonzalez-Gonzalez 2017. Mexican ceratopsids: Considerations on their diversity and evolution. Journal of South American Earth Sciences 75: 66–73. doi:10.1016/j.jsames.2017.01.008
